caption: The drawing depicts a green, duck-shaped vessel with a textured surface featuring numerous circular indents or raised dots. The vessel has a pronounced angular tail extending upwards, a lid with two vertical, fin-like projections, and a stylized head with a beak at the front. The body and lid of the vessel display a subtle dividing line, emphasizing that the lid is a separate piece from the base. There is a brownish or golden line along the seam where the lid meets the base. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a small, cursive signature below the vessel on the left side. The composition is centered on the page with the object shown in three-quarter view.
title: Whittled Bowl with Lid: "Hen on Nest"
